title: OpenKNX test bench configuration
description: The one description of the test bench (rig): the devices under test, the other interfaces, the TP devices and the bench power. Kept next to Run-Tests.ps1 as Test-Bench-Config.json, local to this computer. The profiles in Profiles/ refer to it instead of repeating the addresses.

device.description: One device that can be the device under test or the traffic interface of a run.

ip.description: IP address of the device under test (-Ip).

pa.description: Individual address of the device under test (-BdutPa). The run reads the address the device reports; an explicit -BdutPa that differs aborts.

role.description: Interface or Router (-Role). Decides which cases apply: a router is expected to advertise ROUTING, an interface must not.

hardwareBusmonitor.description: Whether the device has a hardware busmonitor (-Busmon). The busmonitor cases run only with yes.

rig.description: Everything around the device under test that is the same for every run on this bench.

witnessIp.description: An interface with a hardware busmonitor that watches the line (-WitnessIp). It must be neither the device under test nor the traffic interface.

p2pTarget.description: A TP device on the line that answers point-to-point requests (-P2pTarget).

deviceTargets.description: The TP devices the device stage judges, comma separated (-DeviceTargets).

testGa.description: Group address(es) only the target acts on, for the device cases that write a group telegram (-TestGa).

serialPort.description: Serial console of the device under test (-SerialPort), e.g. /dev/cu.usbmodem3101 or COM5. The hardening stage drives the FTC client over it and is skipped without it.

ftcTarget.description: The TP device the FTC client works against in the hardening stage (-FtcTarget).

referenceIp.description: A certified interface to compare against (-ReferenceIp). Used when referenceIps is empty.

referenceIps.description: Several certified interfaces for the Fidelity and Reference stages, comma separated (-ReferenceIps).

speedTarget.description: The TP device that receives the throughput transfer of the Speed stage (-SpeedTarget).

speedKb.description: Payload in KB per transfer mode of the Speed stage (-SpeedKb). A string holding a number.

multicast.description: Routing multicast group of the run (-Multicast). 224.0.23.12 is the production group: with it the routing suite is dropped, so a rig uses a lab group such as 224.0.23.13.

powerGuard.description: Rig power guard (-PowerGuard). With on, the bench power relays are checked before every stage and before a restart is judged, and protectedTargets is enforced.

powerRelayWrite.description: Relay switch group addresses, comma separated (-PowerRelayWrite). A GroupValue_Write 1 switches a relay on. The first one must cut the TP of every device in powerRelayFeeds.

powerRelayStatus.description: Relay status group addresses, in the order of powerRelayWrite (-PowerRelayStatus).

powerRelayVia.description: The interface every guard telegram goes through (-PowerRelayVia). It must not hang on the relays itself.

protectedTargets.description: Devices that power the rig (-ProtectedTargets). With the guard on, no restart, master reset, address, memory or property write is sent to them.

powerRelayFeeds.description: Devices under test whose TP the relays cut, by IP (-PowerRelayFeeds). The KNX-fault cases of the DeviceState stage run only for a device in this list.

allowedLines.description: The TP lines the rig owns, as area.line, e.g. 1.1. The run aborts before the first telegram when the device under test, p2pTarget, ftcTarget or a deviceTargets entry lies on another line.

note.description: Why these lines, for the reader.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so an editor shows the field descriptions and checks the file.

networkInterface.description: The network interface of this computer that is wired to the bench, e.g. en0, eth0 or "Ethernet 2". Tools/Test-RigNetwork.ps1 checks and sets the routes for it. Empty when the computer has only one interface in the bench subnet.

devices.description: The KNXnet/IP devices of the bench by a short name of your choice, e.g. interface and router. A profile names its device under test and its traffic interface by these names.
